about: Date and time vectors. Each entry of dateTimes is a case of parseDateTime(input, label, zone), and each entry of timeZones is a case of the reader of a time zone.
label: Start

dateTimes.note: ISO with a space, winter time (CET, +01:00)
seconds that are not zero show in the local text
nine digits of fraction are cut to milliseconds, not rounded
spaces around and inside are ignored
Z: the local text shows the Berlin time
the incident of 2026-09-25: the local text shows the shift at once
six digits of fraction, as Calendly sends
